title: Saif Ali Khan, Vidya Balan Reunite for Ritesh Batra's Long Years Ago in Mumbai
excerpt: Melanie Laurent joins the pair in Batra's family drama about relatives whose failure to talk comes to a head, produced by Poetic Licence and Jio Studios with Good Chaos backing.
body:
• Saif Ali Khan and Vidya Balan will star with French actor Melanie Laurent in Ritesh Batra's Long Years Ago, now filming in Mumbai, according to Cinema Express citing Deadline.
  • The film revolves around a family whose members' hesitance to speak to each other comes to a head; Variety India describes it as a love story positioned within a family frame.
  • Producers are Batra and Adeel Ahmed under Poetic Licence, Jyoti Deshpande under Jio Studios, with Good Chaos also backing the film.
  • It is the third film together for Khan and Balan after Parineeta (2005) and Eklavya: The Royal Guard (2007), and Laurent's Hindi debut, Cinema Express said.

Saif Ali Khan and Vidya Balan are reuniting on screen for Long Years Ago, a new film directed by Ritesh Batra that has begun filming in Mumbai, according to Cinema Express. French actor Melanie Laurent has also joined the cast as a lead, the report said, citing Deadline. No release date or release plan was given in the reports.

A family that stops talking

Cinema Express described the story as revolving around a family whose members' hesitance to speak to each other comes to a head. Variety India, reporting on the same production from the Mumbai set, framed it slightly differently, calling it a love story positioned within a family frame and saying Batra is directing Khan in what sources described as his most challenging role to date. The two descriptions are compatible rather than contradictory: a fractured family at the centre, with a love story inside it. Character details for Khan, Balan and Laurent have not been disclosed in either report.

Who is making it

Cinema Express said Batra is producing Long Years Ago along with Adeel Ahmed under their Poetic Licence banner. Jyoti Deshpande is also producing under the Jio Studios banner, and Good Chaos is also backing the film. That combination puts an independent banner led by the director alongside a major studio, a structure that fits a character-led drama of this kind. Filming has commenced in Mumbai; neither report gave a shooting schedule, a completion date or a release window, so any timeline beyond the current Mumbai shoot would be speculation.

A reunion 19 years in the making

The casting reunites Khan and Balan for a third time. They first appeared together in Parineeta in 2005 and then in Eklavya: The Royal Guard in 2007, Cinema Express and Variety India both noted. Variety India put the gap at 19 years since Eklavya and said sources on set reported the pair had settled back into working together easily. For Laurent, Cinema Express said the film marks her Hindi debut. She is known for Quentin Tarantino's Inglourious Basterds (2009), Denis Villeneuve's Enemy (2013) and Michael Bay's 6 Underground (2019).

The reports also placed the leads' recent work. Cinema Express said Khan was recently seen alongside Akshay Kumar in Priyadarshan's Haiwaan, while Balan starred alongside Rajinikanth in Nelson's Jailer 2.

Batra's track record

Batra is best known internationally for The Lunchbox (2013), which both reports cited as the film that established his reputation for intimate, character-driven storytelling. Variety India noted he has previously worked with Robert Redford, Jim Broadbent and Irrfan Khan. That history is the context for this project: a director associated with quiet, performance-led films taking on a family drama built around what its characters fail to say to each other, rather than a plot driven by external events.

What to watch next

For diaspora audiences, the combination is the draw: two established Hindi film leads, a French actor making her Hindi debut, and a director whose best-known film travelled widely with overseas audiences. The next confirmed details to look for are an official synopsis, the full cast list and any statement from Jio Studios or Poetic Licence on release plans. Until the makers announce them, the verified facts are the title, the three leads, the Mumbai shoot and the family premise described above.
